note: Garden art made with Meshy (tools/meshy_assets.py). 'size' is the in-game size in metres of the object's longest side (Amodu is 1.8 m; the world is x360). Primitives in the builder are only layout and collision proxies; these replace their looks.
style: Stylized 3D game asset: hand-sculpted chunky readable shapes, slightly exaggerated proportions, rich saturated natural colours, hand-painted look PBR textures, soft warm lighting feel, clean silhouette. Single object, no base, no ground plane, no background.

assets.prompt: An ox-eye daisy flower on one slender curved green stem with two small leaves, bright white petals around a raised golden-yellow centre, flower head facing up.
A single buttercup flower on a thin green stem, five glossy golden-yellow cup-shaped petals, one small lobed leaf.
A small clump of white clover: several three-leaf clover leaves on thin stalks with pale chevron markings, and one round white clover flower head.
A cluster of three red fly agaric toadstools with white spots and white stalks, one large, one medium, one small.
A cluster of layered orange-brown bracket fungus shelves growing from a chunk of tree bark, half-disc shelves with pale rims.
A fallen dry twig with two small side branches and rough grey-brown bark, lying flat.
A single fallen dry apple leaf, slightly curled at the edges, clear veins, golden brown fading to green.
A cluster of five smooth rounded garden pebbles in grey and tan, different sizes, touching each other.
A thick gnarled tree root arching out of the ground and back in like a bridge, deep bark grooves, patches of green moss.
A butterfly with its wings spread wide open and flat, symmetrical, bright orange wings with black veins and white spots along black edges, slim black body, two antennae.
A fuzzy round honeybee in flight, wings spread out to the sides, golden-yellow and black striped body, small legs tucked under.
A dragonfly with four long clear veined wings spread flat out to the sides, long slender metallic blue-green body, big round eyes.
A water strider pond skater insect standing on water: slim dark brown body and four very long thin legs spread wide, two short front legs.

A frog tadpole (pollywog): a smooth glossy dark grey-black oval blob body with no fins and no scales, two tiny eyes on top, and one long thin flat tail with a soft translucent edge fin. Simple, amphibian larva, not a fish.
A small rugged adventurer's backpack in olive canvas with brown leather straps and buckles, a rolled blanket on top and side pockets for tools, empty straps (no person).
A small brown leather satchel bag with a flap, a brass clasp and a long shoulder strap, for carrying loot. No person.
A small olive canvas belt pouch with a flap and a button, for carrying small tools. No person.

A child's school backpack standing upright on the ground: blue canvas body, a darker navy front pocket with a zip and pull tab, a main zip curving over the top, padded shoulder straps hanging at the back, a grab loop on top, a small keyring charm on the zip. Worn and well used, a few scuffs and stitched seams.
A seven-spot ladybird beetle walking: glossy domed bright red wing cases with black spots, black head with small white patches, six short black legs, short antennae.
A green aphid insect: soft plump pear-shaped pale green body, six thin legs, long thin antennae, two small tubes at the back end.
A red velvet mite: a round plump fuzzy bright red body like velvet, eight short red legs, tiny head at the front.
A springtail (collembola) tiny soil hexapod: soft segmented grey-blue body, short antennae, six short legs, a small forked tail tucked underneath.
A cluster of five small bioluminescent mushrooms of different heights on thin pale stems, glowing soft cyan-green translucent caps with gills underneath.

A single dandelion seed parachute standing upright: a small slim brown seed at the bottom, a long thin pale stalk rising from it, topped by a wide white fluffy umbrella of fine radiating silky hairs (the pappus), like an open parasol. One seed, symmetrical.

A dandelion plant: one tall straight hollow pale green stalk with a single bright yellow shaggy flower head of many thin petals facing up, and a rosette of long jagged toothed green leaves spread flat around the base.

A dandelion seed head (clock): one tall straight pale green stalk topped by a perfect white fluffy sphere of many seed parachutes radiating from the centre, a few seeds missing, and a rosette of long jagged green leaves flat around the base.

A single red metal crown bottle cap, right way up: a flat round top with a slightly raised centre and a short crimped skirt of fluted teeth all round the rim, glossy red paint scuffed to silver at the edges, hollow underneath.
A ripe red apple fallen on the ground, lying on its side, a bruised patch and one side pecked open showing pale juicy flesh, short brown stem.
A gnawed apple core: a narrow bitten waist of pale browning flesh with brown pips showing, a cap of red apple skin at each end, a short stem at the top.
A yellow hexagonal wooden pencil, sharpened to a point at one end with bare pale wood and a dark graphite tip, a silver metal ferrule and a pink rubber eraser at the other end.
A garden hand trowel: a pointed, slightly dished steel scoop blade joined by a short bent metal neck to a green wooden handle with a hanging hole near its end.
A wooden hand brush for sweeping, as used with a dustpan: a flat varnished wooden back that narrows into a long straight handle, a dense block of stiff black bristles under the wide head.
